title: ToxiGAN: Toxic Data Augmentation via LLM-Guided Directional Adversarial Generation
reasoning: The paper presents a technical method for data augmentation to improve the detection of toxic language. While the datasets used for evaluation contain categories for hate speech targeted at religion, and the paper includes a standard 'Ethical Statement', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the research. The focus is on the algorithmic contribution.
